rows.text: A legend circulates in the city of Okhema: a falling star descended into the Abyss of Fate, bringing with it a Deliverer from beyond the sky. The priests and treasure hunters searched the area, finding meteorite fragments scattered everywhere. They collected these pieces to craft talismans, believing that one day they would help people break free from the shackles of destiny. Some say this story was fabricated by Zagreus's followers: how could a celestial meteor be so easily refined? Yet even if the material of these pendants isn't genuine, the spirit dwelling within them holds real power.
